oracles.claim: For a fixed RNG tape and message, the pinned reference build shall reproduce the recorded CROSS key and signature bytes and shall accept them.
oracles.source_reference: CROSS round-2 spec §7 (PDF p.47); Algorithm 1-3; plans/specs/cross-round2-spec.pdf sha256 10ac1ef5
limitations: Fixtures are generated from the pinned upstream reference implementation with a fixed tape, not from an official round-2 KAT file
A mismatch violates the pinned reference profile, not the CROSS specification by itself

controls.positive_control: the recorded fixture decodes to the recorded ABI lengths
controls.negative_control: a different tape produces different signature bytes

oracles.claim: A CROSS signature produced by an honest signer shall verify under the matching public key for empty and binary messages.
oracles.source_reference: CROSS round-2 spec §2.2 Algorithms 1-3 (PDF pp.16-23); §4 Table 4 (PDF p.31)
limitations: Verification success is not an EUF-CMA or sUF-CMA result

controls.positive_control: a freshly generated key pair signs and verifies
controls.negative_control: a one-byte signature mutation is rejected by cross_exact_lengths and cross_vector_padding

oracles.claim: Two pinned CROSS builds of the same variant, category, corner, and revision exchanging keys and signatures shall cross-verify.
oracles.source_reference: CROSS round-2 spec §2.2 and §4 Table 4; Algorithm 3 verify contract
limitations: Disabled in the pinned single-implementation lock because only one reference build is vendored
Different optimization corners are not interchangeable positive controls

controls.negative_control: the pair file declares signature_exchange before the oracle is enabled

oracles.claim: A CROSS signature shall not verify for a message that differs from the signed message, nor under an independent honest public key.
limitations: Failure to verify under another honest key is not a rogue-key proof
A valid signature on a new message is not automatically an EUF forgery

controls.positive_control: the original message under the original key verifies
controls.negative_control: the mutation record shows the message or public key bytes changed

oracles.claim: The CROSS verifier shall require the exact CROSS_sig_t length and reject truncated or appended signature byte strings.
oracles.source_reference: CROSS round-2 spec §2.2.2 signature sizes (PDF p.23); §5.4 packing (PDF pp.43-44); api.h CRYPTO_BYTES
limitations: Length-aware wrapper observations are labelled api_layer=adapter

controls.negative_control: the mutation record shows one byte appended or removed

oracles.claim: Packed y, v, and vG coefficients outside Fp/Fz shall not be accepted as zero or silently reduced: decapsulation of every wire representation must be canonical.
oracles.source_reference: CROSS round-2 spec Algorithm 3 membership checks; §5.4 packing (PDF pp.43-44); §5.5 arithmetic (PDF p.45); pack_unpack.c unpack_fp_vec
limitations: Internal Mersenne redundant-zero representations are not wire-level coefficients

controls.negative_control: the mutation record marks the target coefficient out of range

oracles.claim: Each densely packed vector is zero-padded to a byte boundary; a decoder shall reject non-zero unused padding bits rather than deriving the same value from two encodings.
oracles.source_reference: CROSS round-2 spec §5.4 packing requires zero padding (PDF pp.43-44); pack_unpack.c unpack checks
limitations: Byte-aligned vectors have no padding case

controls.negative_control: the mutation targets a bit above the coefficient bit width

oracles.claim: The fixed-weight challenge shall be derived from the digest by the specified sampler: chall1 entries are nonzero, chall2 has Hamming weight exactly w, and an independent model shall reproduce the same bit string.
oracles.source_reference: CROSS round-2 spec §2.3 Table 3 (PDF pp.23-24); expand_digest_to_fixed_weight in csprng_hash.c
limitations: Only the rejection sampler path is exercised; probability histograms alone do not establish the predicate

controls.positive_control: the model sampler reproduces the reference challenge for the fixed digest
controls.negative_control: a digest mutation changes the challenge

oracles.claim: Verification shall recompute both final digests and accept if and only if they match the committed roots; changing digest_cmt, digest_chall2, or any response shall reject.
oracles.source_reference: CROSS round-2 spec §2.2 Algorithm 3 lines 22-28 (PDF pp.22-23)
limitations: The independent recomputation is supplied by the Python transcript model; the native oracle observes rejection

controls.negative_control: each targeted field mutation is recorded as effective

oracles.claim: Every Hash/CSPRNG call shall use the specified little-endian 16-bit role tag and digest length; the transcript model with the same tags shall reproduce the reference digests.
oracles.source_reference: CROSS round-2 spec §5.1 domain separation (PDF pp.32-33) and §2.2
limitations: Specification §2.2.2 cmt1 text omits Salt while Algorithms 2-3 include it; the model follows the algorithms
Tags are recorded explicitly rather than adding or subtracting one globally

controls.positive_control: the model reproduces the reference digest for unchanged inputs

oracles.claim: RebuildLeaves(SeedPath(seed, salt, b), b, salt) shall recover exactly the published leaves, and the published node set shall equal the zero-challenge round leaves and never cover one-challenge rounds.
oracles.source_reference: CROSS round-2 spec §5.2 SeedTree algorithms (PDF pp.34-42); Algorithms 5-10
limitations: Secret leaves are never written to ordinary reports

controls.positive_control: the reference path rebuilds the honest round leaves
controls.negative_control: a flipped zero-challenge flag tree is detected by the published-set predicate

oracles.claim: Changing an active Proof node, reordering active proof nodes, or corrupting an active Path seed shall make the recomputed root mismatch and verification fail.
oracles.source_reference: CROSS round-2 spec §5.2 Merkle tree algorithms 11-16 (PDF pp.38-42)
limitations: Fast, balanced, and small tree topologies are tested separately; unused slots are covered by cross_path_proof_consumption

controls.positive_control: the honest proof recomputes the honest root
controls.negative_control: the mutation record distinguishes path from proof targets

oracles.claim: Path and Proof consumption shall be decided by the challenge topology and shall match the recorded counts without out-of-bounds or duplicate consumption; unused fixed slots follow the pinned serializer contract.
oracles.source_reference: CROSS round-2 spec §2.2.2 bound and §5.2 tree shape (PDF pp.34-42)
limitations: Remaining-byte rules are not fully specified in text; behaviour is reported as an implementation observation
Unused-slot zeroization is a serializer property, not §5.4 vector padding

controls.positive_control: the honest signature consumes exactly the topology counts
controls.negative_control: an inconsistent challenge/topology fixture consumes a different count

oracles.claim: ExpandSK shall rederive Seedpk and the parity matrix, and the public syndrome shall equal e*H^T (RSDP) or eG*M mod z (RSDPG) under the specified row/column order.
oracles.source_reference: CROSS round-2 spec Algorithm 1 and Algorithm 4 (PDF pp.16-17); §5.3-5.4 arithmetic
limitations: Row/column order is checked against a fixed fixture; a mismatch is reported before any target verdict

controls.positive_control: the reference key satisfies the model syndrome equation
controls.negative_control: a mutated pk seed breaks it

oracles.claim: Key generation and signing shall consume the injected CSPRNG tape deterministically: the same tape reproduces identical bytes on the same build, and a fresh legal tape yields a verifying signature.
oracles.source_reference: CROSS round-2 spec Algorithm 1-2; csprng_hash.c platform_csprng_state; api.h CRYPTO_RANDOMBYTES
limitations: Repeated salt or seed is a diagnostic observation, not automatically a normative rejection
Same-tape equality only holds for the same build and call path

controls.positive_control: two runs under the same tape agree
controls.negative_control: a different tape changes the salt

oracles.claim: Failure paths shall report a consistent status and leave caller output length and buffers bounded by the sentinel/canary contract; parser and allocation budgets shall stay within the configured limits.
oracles.source_reference: CROSS round-2 spec API contract; harness common API contract §1.4
limitations: The production retry policy is not modified; allocation-failure probes report the observed state only

controls.positive_control: the honest path returns success with exact lengths
controls.negative_control: a poisoned output sentinel is detected

oracles.claim: Scalar and batch SHAKE calls shall agree for 1, 2, 3, and 4 lanes including short tail batches; Fp/Fz arithmetic shall agree with independent modular arithmetic on small-domain and boundary operands.
oracles.source_reference: CROSS round-2 spec §5.3-5.5 (PDF pp.44-46); fips202.c and fp_arith.h
limitations: Variable public inputs do not by themselves constitute leakage evidence

controls.positive_control: lane counts that divide the round total agree with the scalar result
controls.negative_control: an intentionally mis-sized tail batch diverges

oracles.claim: A fault that flips the flag tree or shifts a challenge bit shall not cause the same round to disclose both its seed and its zero-branch response; such a mutant must be detected by cross_seed_rebuild.
oracles.source_reference: CROSS round-2 spec §5.6 fault-attack boundary (PDF pp.45-46)
limitations: A signature that merely fails to verify is not a leakage detector

controls.negative_control: the synthetic mutant is caught by the published-seed-set predicate

oracles.claim: The timing lane shall complete within the configured budget while comparing secret-dependent and public verification paths; no timing conclusion is drawn without the dedicated non-sanitized binary and multiple-comparison correction.
oracles.source_reference: CROSS round-2 spec §5.5-5.6 (PDF pp.45-46); harness common §1.4
limitations: Opt-in P2 lane; not part of the default smoke contract
No power or EM claim is made without a physical measurement setup

controls.positive_control: the public verify path is measured in the same harness
controls.negative_control: the lane reports not_applicable when the timing binary is absent
